details: @ngp-ui/auth-client@99.0.0 is a dependency-confusion package with no functional code: it takes a name in the @ngp-ui scope at version 99.0.0, high enough to outrank a same-named package on a private registry. Its preinstall script runs `node preinstall.js` on npm install, which reads the machine's hostname and resolves `<hostname>.ngp-ui.auth-client.oob.jr0ch17[.]com`, sending the hostname of every installing machine to a DNS server controlled by the publisher. The npm account jr0ch17-bb published @ngp-ui/auth-client and 2 sibling @ngp-ui packages with the same script within a minute on 2026-11-27.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
